b-003.reason: departis = 'departed from' (s'en sont departis à la court), the record's word for a retraction; depattis is a wrong sort.

b-009.reason: ont varié = 'they have varied'; oet is no word.

b-013.reason: reiecté = 'rejected' (doit estre reiecté); reicté drops a letter.

n-e-3.reason: de teſt. = De testibus, the title of Novel 90 in collatio 7 of the Authenticum, which the note cites; reading A leaves a letter unread.
